finals.race: EBF Desert Crown Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: From the family of the trainer's high-class sprinter Starman, but offered little on debut when last of 4 in novice at Salisbury (6f) in July, reported to have lost her action. Tongue strap fitted after 3 months off.

finals.race: Lords Taverners Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Lost his way last season but took advantage of his reduced mark when starting out for this yard at Ffos Las 3 weeks ago and remains well treated on old form up 7 lb. Can follow up.

finals.race: Lords Taverners Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: One-time useful handicap hurdler for Paul Nicholls but little form since 2023/24, showing only a glimmer of ability on second start for this yard at Uttoxeter 19 days ago.

finals.race: Ladies Day 8th May On Sale Now Handicap
finals.comment: Has won twice at this track this year, including over C&D 21 days ago. Just a respectable fourth of 9 here on heavy going last week and needs a step forward.

finals.race: Free Tips On attheraces.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £240,000 purchase after winning his sole outing in Irish points and confirmed the promise of his bumper debut when landing the odds in 4-runner contest at Carlisle in March. Form from both bumpers has been boosted since and looks a good prospect for hurdling.

finals.race: Free Tips On attheraces.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Took a step forward from his first outing when fourth of 8 in bumper at Stratford a month ago, despite still looking in need of the experience. Step up in trip should suit as he starts off over hurdles.

finals.race: Free Tips On attheraces.com Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Half-brother to a well above-average staying chaser and showed a bit more than on debut when fourth of 5 in bumper at Warwick in May. Step up in trip should suit as he goes hurdling, but appeals as more one for the longer term.

finals.race: Racing TV Free Trial For A Month Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: In good hands but low-key start to her career.

finals.race: Racedays For 9 Pound At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Won on UK debut at Carlisle over 1¾m in May. Second of 5 at Haydock 19 days ago following a breathing operation, with the tongue strap removed. Should stay this trip and can figure.

finals.race: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: €62,000 3-y-o, Arrigo gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including smart hurdler/chaser Inthepocket. Has a good pedigree but given a considerate introduction at Carlisle 2 weeks ago.

finals.race: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Geordieland gelding who has merely hinted at ability in a couple of bumpers and a novice hurdle.

finals.race: Experience Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Wootton Bassett colt who reached 575,000 gns as a yearling. Just 5 starts to date but promise in that time and came third last 2 starts. This longer trip looks sure to suit and switch to James Owen could be enough to see him break his duck. Has been gelded and wears first-time cheekpieces.

finals.race: Experience Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Lightly-raced filly who showed fair form when placed last 2 starts. Needs more here but longer trip looks sure to suit and she hails from a top yard so needs considering.

finals.race: Experience Hospitality At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Won back-to-back handicap hurdles in December and January before finishing second of 10 on Flat debut at Redcar 9 days ago after 8 months off, keeping on. Now steps up in trip but could prove vulnerable to younger rivals.

finals.race: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: £40,000 5-y-o, Blue Bresil gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including useful hurdler Highway One O Two, stayed 21f, and useful hurdler/chaser Doctor Harper. Won second of 2 starts in Irish points in January so he's a Rules newcomer of interest.

finals.race: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Lot to like on paper and did show more than on debut when fifth of 12 in a maiden hurdle at Wincanton in March. Off since but should be more to come as he gains experience.

finals.race: LSL Racing 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Sent off 11/2 but always behind when ninth of 10 in bumper at Hereford (2m, soft) in February. Never really dangerous on last month's hurdling debut, either.

finals.race: Start Your Free Trial On Racing TV Now Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Never dangerous in Navan bumper on debut in September but showed much more switched to hurdles at Punchestown (125/1) 3 weeks ago and can improve.

finals.race: Start Your Free Trial On Racing TV Now Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Failed to see his race out on debut in a valuable Punchestown bumper in April but showed a bit more when ninth of 11 in bumper at same course (2m, good to soft) on return last month. Tongue tie applied for this hurdling debut.

finals.race: Lysaght Cup Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Low mileage mare who is built for fences and duly matched her best hurdles form when second of 5 at Uttoxeter on chase bow/return 19 days ago, unable to reel in the race-fit winner. Big shout with a repeat but not sure to be in same form judging on her profile.

finals.race: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
finals.comment: No impact in 3 starts over 2m last season. Potential improver now handicapping upped in trip. RESERVE.

finals.race: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Yet to win a handicap in 6 attempts but ran very well when second of 13 over C&D 28 days ago, travelling best. Unexposed at this trip and is one to take very seriously from 4 lb higher mark.

finals.race: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Best effort when fourth of 10 in minor event over 1m at Southwell in August. Not so good next time but step up in trip looks sure to suit on handicap debut so he's worth a glance in the betting for a stable going very well. Has been gelded.

finals.race: Conference And Events At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Last won over hurdles in February 2025 but hasn't beaten a rival in 3 starts since. Now back on the Flat after 207 days off and is hard to fancy.

finals.race: Unibet's New VAR Goal Guarantee Handicap
finals.comment: Ended 2025 with success at Newcastle in December. Back-to-form second at Ffos Las in June on his final run for Ed Walker but made a low-key start for this yard here 4 weeks ago.

finals.race: Nairns Oatcakes Handicap
finals.comment: C&D winner who scored 3 times during 2025. Shade unfortunate not to have added to his tally this year and, in line with yard's good form, he quickly dispelled a couple of lesser efforts when second at Catterick (7f, heavy) 8 days ago. On a handy mark and respected from a good draw.

finals.race: Nairns Oatcakes Handicap
finals.comment: Fallen long way in the weights and found the drop into a 0-80 liberating to gain a first success since landing the Golden Mile at Goodwood in 2025 at Leicester (1m, heavy) 9 days ago. Remains with handicapping scope under 4-lb penalty for all this demands more back on quicker ground from high draw.

finals.race: Watch Racing TV Now Handicap
finals.comment: Won a handicap at Pontefract in May but has disappointed since and others are preferred.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Foaled April 21. Ghaiyyath filly. Closely related to 2-y-o 6f winner Fiery Damsel and half-sister to 11f winner in Qatar Corpus Juris. Dam, 6f-1m winner, half-sister to very smart winner up to 1½m New London and smart winner up to 2m Al Nayyir. Obvious type given yard's good record with newcomers.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Frankel filly. Half-sister to 7f winner Karvala. Dam 7f/1m winner (including at 2 yrs), second in 1000 Guineas. Well backed but needed the experience when third of 5 in Yarmouth maiden 2 weeks ago. Sure to do better.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: 1,500,000 gns yearling, Frankel filly. Dam, winner up to 1¼m, is a half-sister to smart 7f winner (stays 1¼m) Seraph Gabriel. All the rage in the betting but just didn't have a clue in Salisbury novice 5 weeks ago. Sure to leave that behind in due course. Tongue strap on.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Foaled March 27. Study of Man filly. Sister to 2-y-o 1m winner Aleen and half-sister to 3 winners, including 1½m winner Alpha Theta and winner up to 1½m Alpen Power. Dam, French 1m-1¼m winner, half-sister to smart 1¼m winner Harrovian. Yard 7-88 with 2-y-o newcomers this season.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: €36,000 foal, €220,000 yearling, Sioux Nation filly. Half-sister to minor winner abroad by Starspangledbanner. Dam, 6f winner, sister to useful 5f/6f winner High Award out of smart winner up to 1m (2-y-o 7f winner) Tarascon. Well held in Yarmouth novice 7 weeks ago.

finals.race: Floyds Turfcare & Weed Solutions Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Remains a maiden but was placed on her final start for Emma Lavelle in July. Ran poorly on stable debut, though quickly got back on track when third of 13 in handicap over this C&D 24 days ago.

finals.race: Floyds Turfcare & Weed Solutions Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Made frame both starts in Irish points and showed a bit more than on hurdling debut when sixth of 9 in novice at Uttoxeter (2½m) in March. Drop back to 2m against him when well-beaten fourth here next time, so he could yet do better returned to further on handicap bow.

finals.race: racingtv.com/freetrial Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Confirmed promise of previous effort over 2¾m when winning 12-runner handicap hurdle at Bellewstown in April, suited by the drop back to 17f. Will need to find more again as he goes chasing after 6 months off.

finals.race: racingtv.com/freetrial Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Opened her hurdles account in a first-time hood at Limerick in February but well held in handicaps at Fairyhouse and Punchestown subsequently. Made the frame in a point and could still do better now sent chasing after a break.

finals.race: Thank You For The Fun Gweedore Handicap
finals.comment: Built on encouragement of previous couple of outings when capitalising on a much reduced mark at Catterick 8 days ago, in command 2f out. Carries a penalty but he's a strong contender in his current form, with blinkers back on replacing the visor.

finals.race: Thank You For The Fun Gweedore Handicap
finals.comment: Has a good record here, his last 2 wins over this C&D with the latest in June. Soon bounced back from a lesser effort when second at this track in September, beaten only by a 3-y-o improver.

finals.race: racingtv.com Handicap
finals.comment: Regular slow starter, but switched back to cheekpieces, took advantage of a much reduced mark when ending long losing run in 14-runner contest at Bath 6 days ago, scoring by a length from Just Queen High. Task is now to build on latest effort under a penalty.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Foaled February 21. Too Darn Hot filly. Sister to smart 6f-1m winner Native Approach and closely related to smart 6f-1m winner Discovery Island, and half-sister to 1¼m winner Theatre Honours. Dam, winner up to 1m (2-y-o 7f winner), half-sister to very smart 6f-7f winner Leahurst. Obvious type.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Foaled April 25. Stradivarius filly. Half-sister to 2-y-o 1m winner Urban Glimpse and 2-y-o 8.6f winner Eastern Veil. Dam, 1¼m winner, half-sister to smart 7.6f/8.3f winner Urban Aspect out of useful 1½m winner (stayed 2m) Casual Glance. Looks one for the longer-term on pedigree.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Foaled March 3. €270,000 yearling, Lope De Vega filly. Dam, 1¼m winner, closely related to winner up to 7f Naadirr and 2-y-o 1m-1¼m winner Dubai Mile (both smart). Yard newcomers often better for the run.

finals.race: Unibet/British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
finals.comment: Foaled May 16. €17,000 yearling, resold €48,000 yearling, 65,000 gns 2-y-o, Cracksman filly. Half-sister to 7f-8.6f winner Kitaro Kich. Dam, 1m-10.7f winner, half-sister to useful 5f-7f winner Merhoob. Rare 2-y-o runner for this yard.

finals.race: Dunraven Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Workforce gelding. Dam (b83), lightly raced in bumpers, half-sister to fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser (stayed 3m) Pumped Up Kicks. Won sole start in Irish points (Mar 2026). Yard in top form and got to be on the shortlist.

finals.race: Dunraven Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Passing Glance gelding. Dam (c121/h114), 2m-21f hurdle/chase winner, sister to fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser (stayed 2½m) Barton Knoll. Yard's bumper runners showing up well (had a winner first time up at Carlisle on Sunday).

finals.race: British EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 26. Wootton Bassett colt. Half-brother to useful 1m winner City Queen. Dam useful French 10.5f winner out of winning daughter of Lancashire Oaks winner Pongee. Highly respected on debut with leading yard boasting a fine strike rate with their juveniles.

finals.race: British EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 16. €3,000 foal, 50,000 gns yearling, Almanzor colt. Dam, French winner up to 1m (including at 2 yrs), half-sister to useful 2-y-o 1m-9.5f winner in France Jadhaba. Another who is less-than-ideally drawn on debut.

finals.race: British EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled March 17. 500,000 gns yearling, Sea The Stars colt. Half-brother to useful 7f/7.4f winner Hope Queen. Dam once-raced, half-sister to very smart winner up to 11f Elarqam. Stable's newcomers usually come on plenty for their first run.

finals.race: British EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled March 6. 300,000 gns yearling, Camelot colt. Half-brother to several winners, including very smart winner up to 1m Aclaim, smart 11.6f-13f winner Aimeric. Dam 7f winner.

finals.race: British EBF Future Stayers Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Stoutly bred Stradivarius colt who hails from a family his yard knows well and promise to glean from his debut fourth in a Southwell novice (1m) 3 weeks ago, nearest at the finish without being knocked about. Looks bound to improve, not least when stamina is drawn out further.

finals.race: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
finals.comment: Showed benefit of both a gelding and breathing operation after 5 months off when landing 13-runner Southwell handicap (7f) in August (form franked). Disappointed next time but best not judged too harshly on his subsequent mid-field effort in Balmoral at Ascot. Interesting back on all-weather.

finals.race: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
finals.comment: Completed a hat-trick at Newcastle during first half of 2025 and he ran his best race since this spring when 2 lengths seventh of 11 over 6f here 3 weeks ago, albeit better positioned than most. Edging back down to a competitive mark and he looks worth a crack at this longer trip.

finals.race: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap
finals.comment: Is thriving on racing and made pretty short work of another 8 lb rise to bring up a quick-fire hat-trick in 5f handicap here 5 weeks ago. Another 10 lb hit to overcome in a tougher race but he's impossible to ignore.

finals.race: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: Lightly-raced filly but a dual 6f winner (including over C&D) for Richard Hannon. Showed plenty of spark before shaping as if needing the run after 12 months off at Newcastle in September but despite being well backed, ran flat at Hamilton later that month. Considered dropped in grade.

finals.race: Try Unibet's New Racing Bet Builder Fillies' Handicap
finals.comment: Has had a cracking season and recorded her fourth win of the campaign in determined fashion in 11-runner event over C&D a fortnight ago. Nudged up 3 lb for that and can remain competitive.

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Maiden
finals.comment: Ran well back from 4 months off when 5 lengths second in 7f Naas maiden. Good claims if backing that up on first go on all-weather.

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Maiden
finals.comment: Has shaped as if in need of the experience in a couple of maidens in the last fortnight and will be of more interest in handicaps.

finals.race: Try Unibet's Smartview Racecards Handicap
finals.comment: Has done well since joining this yard, winning at Epsom and Windsor in July. Placed on several occasions since, though was a remote third at Southwell 3 weeks ago. Headgear back on.

finals.race: Try Unibet's Smartview Racecards Handicap
finals.comment: Quirky sort. Successful twice at Wolverhampton earlier in the year. Typically done plenty wrong on her most recent starts and remains best treated with caution.

finals.race: Book Your Christmas Party At Dundalk Stadium Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Much improved in 2025, winning 3 times, but hasn't looked the same straightforward and consistent type this year, again getting going late at Navan last time. Has dropped a long way in the weights if a return to Dundalk can re-ignite her spark.

dropped.race: Lords Taverners Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
dropped.comment: One-time useful handicap hurdler for Paul Nicholls but little form since 2023/24, showing only a glimmer of ability on second start for this yard at Uttoxeter 19 days ago.

dropped.comment: Took a step forward from his first outing when fourth of 8 in bumper at Stratford a month ago, despite still looking in need of the experience. Step up in trip should suit as he starts off over hurdles.
